Subject: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up / pen test + vuln mgmt

Thanks again for the time this morning, Sarah — really appreciate the clear signals on risk posture and timelines. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our side so we can keep momentum.

Call recap (high level):
- You’re evaluating Redwood for customer-facing inference features (payments and statements workflows).
- Primary security asks: SOC 2 timeline, GDPR/HIPAA handling options, vendor security questionnaire, and pen test evidence.
- Procurement will want pen test report and our vuln management SLAs before signing.

Next steps (ask list):
1) I’ll share our mutual action plan and a sanitized pen test summary that we can provide under NDA.
2) Can you share your vendor security questionnaire (or confirm scope) so we can start answers?
3) We’ll loop in our security lead (Rishi) for technical Qs on scanning cadence, patch SLAs, and responsible disclosure.
4) If acceptable, we can sign a short NDA so we can share a redacted full pen test report.

Attachments: redwood_map_v1.pdf (mutual action plan / milestones).

Proposed timing: I’ll send the MAP + pen test summary today; Rishi will follow up with SLAs and process details. If you’d like, we can schedule a short security-only sync next week (30 min).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up / pen test + vuln mgmt

Thanks, Marissa — great summary. A few notes from our side:

- We have a standard vendor security questionnaire; I attached the spreadsheet (finhealth_vendor_qs.xlsx). Please have your security team fill in the controls columns where possible.
- SOC 2: we run annual assessments and require Type II; our procurement team prefers vendors with completed Type II, but we can accept Type I in early-stage cases if there’s a clear plan. Can you confirm Redwood’s SOC 2 status and estimated completion?
- HIPAA/GDPR: We are in scope for HIPAA; any handling of PHI will require BAAs and documented safeguards. Please confirm whether Redwood has BAA options and what controls you apply for PHI-in-transit and at-rest.
- Pen test: procurement will want the most recent pen test report (redacted for customer-sensitive issues is OK). Also need to understand your vulnerability management SLAs and scanning cadence.

We’re happy to sign an NDA for a full report. I’ll get procurement to share our standard NDA (or we can use DocuSign NDA link).

Thanks — I’ll review the MAP and get the questionnaire to you.

-Sarah Liu
Head of Security & Compliance, FinHealth
sarah.liu@finhealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0198

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security & compliance follow-up / pen test + vuln mgmt

Hi Sarah — looping in the security details from Redwood’s side. Below is an actionable summary you can share with procurement/security reviewers. Happy to jump on a call if you prefer.

SOC 2 status:
- Redwood is currently completing SOC 2 Type II for 2027; expected report completion: 2027-08-15. We can share the SOC 2 Type I and interim controls evidence now.

HIPAA / GDPR:
- We support BAA contract language for customers handling PHI. PHI can be segregated in Dedicated or Private modes; hosted customers can also use encryption-at-rest + KMS.
- GDPR: we have standard SCCs and a data processing addendum.

Pen test & report sharing:
- Summary: our most recent independent penetration test was completed Apr 2027. I’ve attached a redacted executive summary (redwood_pen_test_summary_202704.pdf) that is safe to share. For the full technical report we require a short NDA (standard redaction for customer-sensitive PoCs/vulns). If you provide an NDA link or sign ours, we’ll exchange the full report.

Vulnerability management (recommended baseline for procurement):
- Scanning cadence: automated external scans weekly; internal network/app scans bi-weekly; authenticated app scans monthly; dependency/OSS scans on every release pipeline.
- SLA targets for remediation: Critical: acknowledge within 24 hours, mitigation/patch plan within 72 hours; High: remediation plan within 7 days; Medium: 30 days; Low: tracked in roadmap.
- Disclosure policy: We follow coordinated disclosure — vendor fixes or mitigation first, public disclosure only after fix or at agreed embargo. We have an internal PSIRT and dedicated contact for external reports.

Attachments: redwood_pen_test_summary_202704.pdf, redwood_vuln_policy.md (vuln mgmt and disclosure process).

If procurement needs a formal policy doc or a shorter one-pager with SLAs, we can produce that. Also happy to do a 30-min security deep-dive next week (I’m available Tue/Wed afternoon PST).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0133

I’ll kick off the NDA request from our side and loop procurement; assume we’ll need the full report once NDA is done. Also — we’d like to schedule a 30-min security call next Wed (May 19) at 10:00am ET if that works for Rishi/Marissa.
